param.name: scan_interval
param.comment: Scan interval; also controls the short-lived cache TTLs

param.name: max_attack_init_distance
param.comment: Maximum distance at which a new attack may be initiated

param.name: skip_ship_may_attack
param.comment: Allow hostile ships to be considered even when vanilla mayattack is false

param.name: skip_station_may_attack
param.comment: Allow hostile stations to be considered even when vanilla mayattack is false

param.name: attack_ships
param.comment: Include hostile ships in the scan as potential targets

param.name: attack_stations
param.comment: Include hostile stations in the scan as potential targets

param.name: visibility_all_seeing
param.comment: Treat every hostile sector object as visible

param.name: visibility_allied_vision
param.comment: Let friendly objects contribute their vision

param.name: potential_ally_combatant_force_coefficient
param.comment: Weight of nearby friendly VFFs that run a CL-capable order, are hostile to the target, but have not committed yet, when checking attack initiation thresholds - they may pick another target, so they count discounted

param.name: force_estimation_deviation
param.comment: Fog-of-war randomizer: every force estimate is multiplied by a random factor in [1 - deviation, 1 + deviation] (lower bound clamped to 0.1), rerolled right before each comparison

param.name: ship_join_threshold
param.comment: Minimum committed-friendly-force / target-force ratio required before this ship joins an attack on a ship (VFF) that is already under way

param.name: ship_overcommit_limit
param.comment: Stop joining a ship target once committed friendly force exceeds this multiple of the target's force, so one target does not soak the whole sector

param.name: station_join_threshold
param.comment: Minimum committed-force / station-force ratio required before this ship piles onto a station attack that is already under way

param.name: station_initiation_threshold
param.comment: Self VFF force (+ weighted potential ally combatants) / station force ratio required to initiate a fresh station assault

param.name: station_committed_distance
param.comment: An attacking VFF counts as committed to a station only while within this distance of that station

param.name: force_baseline_dps
param.comment: Reference DPS a ship's dps.all is divided by to get its DPS power; ~ingame median destroyer DPS. Ship force = dps power * durability power * mobility power

param.name: force_baseline_durability
param.comment: Reference hull + shield sum for durability power; ~ingame median destroyer hull + shields. Also used for station force (stations have no mobility term)

param.name: force_baseline_maxspeed_cruise
param.comment: Reference cruise maxspeed for cruise mobility power

param.name: force_baseline_maxspeed_travel
param.comment: Reference travel-drive maxspeed for travel mobility power; baseline speed with baseline chargetime gives power 1, zero chargetime gives power 2

param.name: force_baseline_travel_chargetime
param.comment: Reference travel-drive charge time in the travel mobility formula above

param.name: force_baseline_mobility_cruise_weight
param.comment: Cruise share in combined mobility power

param.name: force_baseline_mobility_travel_weight
param.comment: Travel share in combined mobility power

param.name: score_focus_bonus
param.comment: Score bonus for targets already under friendly attack, so fire concentrates on fights in progress

param.name: score_ship_bonus
param.comment: Base score for ship (VFF) targets

param.name: score_station_bonus
param.comment: Base score for station targets

param.name: score_matchup_max_bonus
param.comment: Max size-matchup bonus, granted in full when the target's size band equals own (S=1 M=2 L=3 XL=4, stations=5)

param.name: score_matchup_step_penalty
param.comment: Matchup bonus lost per size-band step between own class and the target's

param.name: score_distance_max_bonus
param.comment: Max closeness bonus; falls off linearly with distance, reaching 0 at max_attack_init_distance

param.name: route_penalty_route_length_min
param.comment: Candidates closer than this skip route penalty checks entirely and are accepted on raw score - nothing meaningful fits between

param.name: route_penalty_corridor_min
param.comment: Lower clamp for the route corridor radius; also the base radius (plus station size) when collecting blocking stations along a leg

param.name: route_penalty_corridor_max
param.comment: Upper clamp for the route corridor radius

param.name: route_penalty_corridor_fraction
param.comment: Route corridor radius = route length * this fraction, clamped between route_penalty_corridor_min and route_penalty_corridor_max

param.name: route_penalty_edge_weight
param.comment: Fraction of a blocker's force still counted at the corridor edge; contribution scales linearly from full force on the route line down to this at the edge

param.name: route_penalty_per_force_ratio
param.comment: Score penalty per 1.0 of blocking-force / self-force ratio accumulated along the route

param.name: route_penalty_cap
param.comment: Upper cap of the total route penalty subtracted from a candidate's score; also lets blocker accumulation stop early once saturated

param.name: debugdirectory
param.comment: debug_to_file output directory; log files inside are per-ship, named by ship idcode
